title: CVE-2024-37383: RoundCube Webmail Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) Vulnerability
summary: RoundCube Webmail contains a cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability in the handling of SVG animate attributes that allows a remote attacker to run malicious JavaScript code.

title: CVE-2024-20481: Cisco ASA and FTD Denial-of-Service Vulnerability
summary: Cisco Adaptive Security Appliance (ASA) and Firepower Threat Defense (FTD) contain a missing release of resource after effective lifetime vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to cause a denial-of-service (DoS) of the RAVPN service.

title: CVE-2024-47575: Fortinet FortiManager Missing Authentication Vulnerability
summary: Fortinet FortiManager contains a missing authentication vulnerability in the fgfmd daemon that allows a remote, unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code or commands via specially crafted requests.

title: CVE-2024-38094: Microsoft SharePoint Deserialization Vulnerability
summary: Microsoft SharePoint contains a deserialization vulnerability that allows for remote code execution.

title: CVE-2024-9537: ScienceLogic SL1 Unspecified Vulnerability
summary: ScienceLogic SL1 (formerly EM7) is affected by an unspecified vulnerability involving an unspecified third-party component.

title: CVE-2024-40711: Veeam Backup and Replication Deserialization Vulnerability
summary: Veeam Backup and Replication contains a deserialization vulnerability allowing an unauthenticated user to perform remote code execution.

title: CVE-2024-28987: SolarWinds Web Help Desk Hardcoded Credential Vulnerability
summary: SolarWinds Web Help Desk contains a hardcoded credential vulnerability that could allow a remote, unauthenticated user to access internal functionality and modify data.

title: CVE-2024-9680: Mozilla Firefox Use-After-Free Vulnerability
summary: Mozilla Firefox and Firefox ESR contain a use-after-free vulnerability in Animation timelines that allows for code execution in the content process.

title: CVE-2024-30088: Microsoft Windows Kernel TOCTOU Race Condition Vulnerability
summary: Microsoft Windows Kernel contains a time-of-check to time-of-use (TOCTOU) race condition vulnerability that could allow for privilege escalation.

title: CVE-2024-9380: Ivanti Cloud Services Appliance (CSA) OS Command Injection Vulnerability
summary: Ivanti Cloud Services Appliance (CSA) contains an OS command injection vulnerability in the administrative console which can allow an authenticated attacker with application admin privileges to pass commands to the underlying OS.

title: CVE-2024-9379: Ivanti Cloud Services Appliance (CSA) SQL Injection Vulnerability
summary: Ivanti Cloud Services Appliance (CSA) contains a SQL injection vulnerability in the admin web console in versions prior to 5.0.2, which can allow a remote attacker authenticated as administrator to run arbitrary SQL statements.

title: CVE-2024-23113: Fortinet Multiple Products Format String Vulnerability
summary: Fortinet FortiOS, FortiPAM, FortiProxy, and FortiWeb contain a format string vulnerability that allows a remote, unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code or commands via specially crafted requests.

title: CVE-2024-43573: Microsoft Windows MSHTML Platform Spoofing Vulnerability
summary: Microsoft Windows MSHTML Platform contains an unspecified spoofing vulnerability which can lead to a loss of confidentiality.

title: CVE-2024-43572: Microsoft Windows Management Console Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
summary: Microsoft Windows Management Console contains unspecified vulnerability that allows for remote code execution.

title: CVE-2024-43047: Qualcomm Multiple Chipsets Use-After-Free Vulnerability
summary: Multiple Qualcomm chipsets contain a use-after-free vulnerability due to memory corruption in DSP Services while maintaining memory maps of HLOS memory.

title: CVE-2024-45519: Synacor Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) Command Execution Vulnerability
summary: Synacor Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) contains an unspecified vulnerability in the postjournal service that may allow an unauthenticated user to execute commands.

title: CVE-2024-29824: Ivanti Endpoint Manager (EPM) SQL Injection Vulnerability
summary: Ivanti Endpoint Manager (EPM) contains a SQL injection vulnerability in Core server that allows an unauthenticated attacker within the same network to execute arbitrary code.
